description: Tests for the listing-drafter skill. Each prompt provides all info upfront so the drafter can complete Steps A–D without interactive follow-up. Evals focus on the drafter's output (draft text shown to user + saved action file), not browser automation.

evals.name: standard-electronics-with-shipping
evals.prompt: I want to list my Logitech MX Master 3S wireless mouse. EAN: 5099206099111. Condition: used, a few minor scratches on the scroll wheel but fully functional. Shipping: yes, Klein size, DE + EU. Listing type: Sofort-Kaufen. For the price, please look up recent eBay sold listings and suggest something reasonable — I'll go with your recommendation. I have 3 photos ready. Please list on all three platforms and go ahead with the full listing workflow.
evals.expected_output:
Drafter asks about marketplace selection (all three selected). Produces complete bilingual eBay description starting with

[title]

, KA description starting with item title as first line, Vinted description starting with item title as first line; verbatim disclaimers in tags for eBay, German-only KA description with KA-specific disclaimer, short bilingual Vinted description with eBay disclaimer and no HTML. eBay price in .99 format, KA price rounded full euro. CONDITION_DROPDOWN_KA=Gut (explicit minor scratches), VINTED_CONDITION=Gut, EBAY_CONDITION=Gebraucht (used item), VINTED_SHIPPING=Vinted-Versand (Klein maps to Vinted-Versand). Action file saved to a per-item run folder under ./Listings/. EBAY_APPLIES=yes, KA_APPLIES=yes, VINTED_APPLIES=yes. ITEM_TITLE ≤ 80 chars. VINTED_TITLE present only if ITEM_TITLE exceeds 50 chars.

evals.name: small-boxed-device-stays-standard-tier
evals.prompt: Ich verkaufe ein Bosch Smart Home Heizkörperthermostat II BTH-RA, gebraucht, wenig Gebrauchsspuren, voll funktionsfähig, mit OVP. Versand: ja, Klein, DE+EU. Sofort-Kaufen, 32,99 €. 4 Fotos. Alle drei Plattformen.
evals.expected_output: Drafter picks the `standard` tier policy ("Paket bis 5 kg DE & EU") for eBay — a small but boxed/rigid smart-home device is NOT letter-tier; the letter tiers are only for genuinely flat, envelope-shippable items. KA methods for Klein are the envelope variant (Hermes Päckchen + DHL Paket 2 kg), independent of the eBay tier. VINTED_TITLE drops the all-caps model code BTH-RA ("Bosch Smart Home Heizkörperthermostat II"), which stays in ITEM_TITLE and the description body. VINTED_CATEGORY is the Smarte Thermostate leaf, not Smarte Steckdosen & Schalter. Validator exits 0.

assertions.name: ebay-policy-is-standard-tier
assertions.description: Small boxed device does not get downgraded to a letter-tier policy
assertions.check: SHIPPING_EBAY_POLICY is the config's `standard` tier policy name, not `letter_minimal`/`letter_large`

assertions.name: ka-klein-uses-envelope-methods
assertions.description: Klein defaults to the envelope variant regardless of the eBay tier
assertions.check: SHIPPING_KA_METHODS contains 'Hermes Päckchen' and 'DHL Paket 2 kg'

assertions.name: vinted-title-drops-model-code
assertions.description: All-caps model codes are removed from the Vinted title
assertions.check: VINTED_TITLE contains no 'BTH-RA'; ITEM_TITLE still does

assertions.name: vinted-thermostat-leaf
assertions.description: Thermostats use the Smarte Thermostate leaf

evals.name: klein-keeps-envelope-methods-and-warnings-resolved
evals.prompt: Ich verkaufe einen Philips Hue Bewegungsmelder, gebraucht, voll funktionsfähig, ohne OVP. Versand: ja, Klein, DE+EU. Sofort-Kaufen, 17,99 €. 3 Fotos. Alle drei Plattformen.
evals.expected_output: SHIPPING_KA_SIZE=Klein takes the envelope variant (Hermes Päckchen + DHL Paket 2 kg) — the box variant is only for a Klein item that genuinely needs a box, and this is not one. VINTED_PACKAGE_SIZE follows the Klein→Klein mapping. The approved draft text and the action file state the SAME shipping methods. The Step D validator gate exits 0 and any warning is explicitly resolved or justified to the user, not merely listed. VINTED_CATEGORY uses a real leaf: a motion sensor has no leaf of its own, so Smart-Home-Hubs — never the non-existent 'Sicherheitskameras & Sensoren'.

assertions.name: klein-uses-envelope-methods
assertions.description: Klein defaults to the envelope variant
assertions.check: SHIPPING_KA_METHODS contains 'Hermes Päckchen'; validator emits no Klein/Päckchen warning

assertions.name: vinted-size-matches-ka-size
assertions.description: Vinted package size follows the KA size mapping

assertions.name: draft-text-matches-action-file
assertions.description: The shipping methods shown to the user equal the ones written to the action file
assertions.check: The methods named in the approval draft are byte-identical to SHIPPING_KA_METHODS

assertions.name: no-invented-vinted-leaf
assertions.description: Vinted leaf exists in the real taxonomy
assertions.check: VINTED_CATEGORY leaf is one of the nine real Smart Home & Sicherheit leaves; not 'Sicherheitskameras & Sensoren'

assertions.name: warnings-resolved-not-listed
assertions.description: Validator warnings are fixed or explicitly justified
assertions.check: Any validator warning is either absent or accompanied by a stated reason in the draft summary

evals.name: KA shipping methods are a floor, never an exclusive pair
evals.prompt: Item is a rigid boxed Shelly relay, Kleinanzeigen size Klein, shipping offered DE+EU.
evals.expected_output: Hermes Päckchen is omitted (item is not letter-flat) and the larger methods stay selected; no method is deactivated for being too large.
assertions: SHIPPING_KA_METHODS does not contain 'Hermes Päckchen' for a rigid boxed item
the draft never deselects a larger method that Kleinanzeigen offers
the validator emits no Klein-lacks-Päckchen warning (that v2.6.4 check was removed in 2.6.5)

evals.name: Price ending in 9 gets ,99 appended, not a cent subtracted
evals.prompt: User says: Preis 299 Euro.
evals.expected_output: EBAY_PRICE 299.99 and VINTED_PRICE 299.99; KA_PRICE 299.
assertions: a price ending in 0 still loses a cent (250 -> 249.99)

evals.name: Quantity survives the handoff
evals.prompt: User says they have 2 identical sets of batteries to sell on all three platforms.
evals.expected_output: EBAY_QUANTITY is 2; KA and Vinted descriptions describe exactly one set with no multi-set language.
assertions: EBAY_QUANTITY: 2 is present in the action file
KA_DESCRIPTION and VINTED_DESCRIPTION contain no phrase implying multiple units
the eBay lister reads the quantity field back after setting it

evals.name: feedback.md is written even when the run ends early
evals.prompt: A run drafts an item, saves the KA draft, then the browser tooling goes down and the run cannot continue.
evals.expected_output: feedback.md exists in the run folder describing how far the run got and why it stopped.
assertions: feedback.md is present even though no lister was 'last'
the header carries the version from the SKILL.md Plugin version line, not 'unbekannt'
writing learnings to project memory instead does not satisfy the rule

evals.name: platforms config restricts what is offered
evals.prompt: Seller config has `platforms: kleinanzeigen, vinted` (no eBay policies configured). User: 'Verkauf meine Logitech MX Master 3S, gebraucht, voll funktionsfähig, Versand DE, Klein, 3 Fotos im Ordner — auf allen Plattformen bitte.'
evals.expected_output: Step A0 offers only Kleinanzeigen.de and Vinted.de (both pre-selected); eBay is neither offered nor mentioned as missing. Action file has EBAY_APPLIES=no with no eBay description block, KA_APPLIES=yes, VINTED_APPLIES=yes. The drafter does not ask for eBay shipping policies. Validator exits 0.
assertions: the platform question lists exactly the configured platforms
EBAY_APPLIES is no and the eBay description block is absent
no question about eBay shipping policies is asked
with `platforms: vinted` alone the drafter skips the question and states it is drafting for Vinted
